breve: Object for storing OpenXR structure data.
descricao: Object for storing OpenXR structure data that is passed when calling into OpenXR APIs.

metodos.desc: Returns the structure type (OpenXR XrStructureType) used for this structure.

propriedades.desc: Setting another structure object here chains these structures together to extend the API functionality. Consult the OpenXR documentation for which structures can be used with a given API call.
